description: Which Italian comuni match: region, province, population range, purchase-price and rent ranges (OMI), population change 2019–2025, the eight shortlist filters (January low, days above 30 C, regional hospital-care score, all three care scores at 60, tourist beds per resident, outside seismic zone 1, road time to a hospital with inpatient beds, road time to an airport) and/or the verified comuni of a tax regime. Paged (max 100) and sortable. Healthcare scores are region grain (autonomous-province grain for Bolzano and Trento): every town in the region shares the score. A comune with no price, rent, population-change, climate, healthcare, tourism, seismic or drive-time figure is left out of the filter on it and COUNTED in `missingData` — never treated as cheap, free or stable; say how many were left out. The taxRegime filter lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes: a comune missing from it is NOT a 'no' (the response says so in `taxRegime.note`). Rows carry plain numbers; their source and vintage are in `figures`. Use search_comuni to turn a town name into a code, get_comune for one town's full profile.

allCareScoresAtLeast60.description: [UI key nsg60] true: the NSG prevention, community-care and hospital-care scores must all be at least 60. Region grain (autonomous-province grain for Bolzano and Trento). A comune missing any of the three is left out and counted.

emergencyDeaOnly.description: [UI key edlevel=dea] With maxEmergencyDriveMinutes: count only a DEA (level I or II), not a Pronto Soccorso. A DEA is a larger emergency department with more specialties on site. Ignored without maxEmergencyDriveMinutes.

excludeSeismicZone1.description: [UI key seis] true: leave out comuni in official seismic zone 1, the highest hazard class (hazard class 4 in the map layer). A legal classification from the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile (31 May 2025), not a forecast. A comune with no single classification is left out and counted.

maxAirportDriveMinutes.description: [UI key adrive] Minutes by road from the comune's main town to the nearest of the airports where ENAC recorded at least 4,000 passengers in 2025 (it leaves out Taranto-Grottaglie and Brescia-Montichiari, which carried almost none), at most this; one of 60, 90, 120, 180. Town grain, free-flow, approximate; says nothing about flights. No figure: left out and counted.

maxBedsPerResident.description: [UI key beds] Registered tourist beds per resident (ISTAT, 2024) at most this; one of 0.1, 0.5, 1. Town grain. A comune with no figure is left out and counted; a real zero is a figure.

maxDaysAbove30C.description: [UI key heat] Average days a year above 30 C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024) at most this many, 0 to 120. Town grain. No figure: left out and counted.

maxEmergencyDriveMinutes.description: [UI key edrive] Minutes by road from the comune's main town to the nearest emergency department in the Ministero della Salute's emergency network (sites active at 31 December 2025: DEA level II, DEA level I or Pronto Soccorso; OpenStreetMap roads) at most this; one of 15, 30, 45, 60. Town grain, free-flow, approximate; not a service guarantee. Combine with emergencyDeaOnly to count only DEA level I or II. A comune with no figure is left out and counted.

maxHospitalDriveMinutes.description: [UI key hdrive] Minutes by road from the comune's main town to the nearest hospital with inpatient beds (Ministero della Salute 2023 list, OpenStreetMap roads) at most this; one of 15, 30, 45, 60. Town grain, free-flow, approximate. Not necessarily a hospital with an emergency department. A comune with no figure (for example a ferry-only island) is left out and counted.

maxPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive.

maxPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

maxRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

minHospitalCareScore.description: [UI key hosp] Ministero della Salute NSG 2024 hospital-care score at least this, 50 to 100; 60 is the official sufficiency line. REGION grain: every comune in a region shares its region's score, except Bolzano-province and Trento-province comuni, which carry their own autonomous province's score. No figure: left out and counted.

minJanuaryLowC.description: [UI key jan] Average January daily minimum (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024) at least this many degrees C, whole numbers -10 to 12. Town grain. A comune with no figure is left out and counted in missingData.

minPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive. A negative value means decline.

minPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

minRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

order.description: Default: desc for population, populationChange, januaryLow and hospitalCareScore; asc for name, purchasePrice, rent, daysAbove30C, bedsPerResident, seismicClass, hospitalDriveMinutes, emergencyDriveMinutes, deaDriveMinutes, airportDriveMinutes, supermarketDriveMinutes, pharmacyDriveMinutes and stationDriveMinutes.

province.description: A province's two-letter code ("AQ") or slug ("l-aquila").

q.description: Only comuni whose name contains this (case- and accent-insensitive).

region.description: A region name or slug, e.g. "Abruzzo" or "valle-d-aosta".

sort.description: Sort key. A comune without a figure for the sort key always sorts last.

taxRegime.description: A verified geographic regime slug from /tax/regimes. Lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes; a comune missing from the list is NOT a "no" (the rule may admit comuni by routes not yet encoded).

missingData.description: One entry per figure you filtered on: how many comuni were left out for having no figure.

excluded.description: Comuni that passed every filter not about this figure but have no figure, so could not be tested and are left out. Price, rent and population change are counted against every other filter except their own and can overlap. The nine shortlist filters (januaryLow, daysAbove30C, hospitalCareScore, allCareScores, bedsPerResident, seismicClass, hospitalDrive, emergencyDrive, airportDrive) are counted in that fixed order, each against the comuni that reached it, exactly as the /data funnel does.

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

bedsPerResident.description: Registered tourist beds per resident (ISTAT, 2024). Town grain. A real zero is 0; null: no figure.

communityCareScore.description: NSG 2024 community and district care score, 0 to 100. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

daysAbove30C.description: Average days a year above 30 C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024). Town grain. null: no figure.

hospitalCareScore.description: NSG 2024 hospital-care score, 0 to 100; 60 is the official sufficiency line. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

januaryLowC.description: Average January daily minimum, C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024). Town grain, nearest ~9 km grid cell. null: no figure.

nearestAirportKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestAirportName. null: no figure.

nearestAirportMinutes.description: Minutes by road from the comune's main town, free-flow, approximate. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestAirportName.description: Nearest of the airports where ENAC recorded at least 4,000 passengers in 2025 (positions from OurAirports; Taranto-Grottaglie and Brescia-Montichiari, which carried almost none, are left out). Says nothing about flights. null: no figure.

nearestDeaKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestDeaName. null: no figure.

nearestDeaLevel.description: The Ministry's level of nearestDeaName: DEA2 = DEA level II, DEA1 = DEA level I. null: no figure.

nearestDeaMinutes.description: Minutes by road to nearestDeaName, free-flow, approximate. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestDeaName.description: Nearest hospital the same Ministry list gives as DEA level II or DEA level I (Pronto Soccorso sites left out). Often the same hospital as nearestEmergencyName. null: no figure.

nearestEmergencyKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestEmergencyName. null: no figure.

nearestEmergencyLevel.description: The Ministry's emergency level of nearestEmergencyName: DEA2 = DEA level II, DEA1 = DEA level I, PS = Pronto Soccorso (a smaller emergency department than a DEA). null: no figure.

nearestEmergencyMinutes.description: Minutes by road to nearestEmergencyName (Ministry emergency network; roads © OpenStreetMap contributors). null: no figure.

nearestEmergencyName.description: Nearest hospital the Ministero della Salute lists in its emergency network (sites active at 31 December 2025) as DEA level II, DEA level I or Pronto Soccorso. A Pronto Soccorso is not the same as a DEA. Not a service guarantee. null: no figure.

nearestHospitalKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestHospitalName. null: no figure.

nearestHospitalMinutes.description: Minutes by road from the comune's main town, free-flow, approximate. Town grain. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestHospitalName.description: Nearest hospital with inpatient beds (Ministero della Salute 2023 list), by road. Not necessarily one with an emergency department. null: no figure.

nearestPharmacyKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestPharmacyName. null: no figure.

nearestPharmacyMinutes.description: Minutes by road from the comune's main town, free-flow, approximate. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestPharmacyName.description: Nearest pharmacy in the Ministero della Salute's open register (ordinary and branch pharmacies). Says nothing about opening hours or duty. null: no figure.

nearestStationKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestStationName. null: no figure.

nearestStationMinutes.description: Minutes by road from the comune's main town, free-flow, approximate. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestStationName.description: Nearest railway station with passenger service (OpenStreetMap, volunteer mapping; metro, tram and heritage lines left out). Says nothing about train frequency. null: no figure.

nearestSupermarketKm.description: Kilometers by road to nearestSupermarketName. null: no figure.

nearestSupermarketMinutes.description: Minutes by road from the comune's main town, free-flow, approximate. null: no figure (never 0).

nearestSupermarketName.description: Nearest supermarket (OpenStreetMap shop=supermarket, volunteer mapping: a store missing from the map is missing here; small grocers are not counted). null: no figure.

nsgGrain.description: Whose NSG scores these are: the comune's region, or for Bolzano-province and Trento-province comuni their own autonomous province (scored separately, never averaged). null when the comune has no NSG score.

page.description: The comune's profile page on expatliving.it.

populationChangePct.description: Percent change 2019 to 2025; null: no figure.

preventionScore.description: NSG 2024 prevention score, 0 to 100. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

purchasePriceEurM2.description: null: no OMI price for this comune. Never a zero. OMI is Agenzia delle Entrate's official range of market values per m2, built from recorded sales and appraisals. Asking prices on listing sites are what sellers hope for, and usually run higher.

rentPriceEurM2Month.description: null: no OMI rent figure for this comune. Never a zero.

seismicClass.description: Hazard class 1 (lowest) to 4 (highest), as on the map layer. Always read it with seismicZone. null: no single classification.

seismicZone.description: The official zona sismica (1 = highest hazard), 5 minus seismicClass. A legal classification from the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile (31 May 2025), not a forecast or a verdict on any building.

taxRegime.description: Present only when taxRegime was filtered on.

qualifyingComuniInItaly.description: Size of the regime's verified set, before any other filter.

total.description: Comuni matching every filter, before paging.
